message.content:
Below are a few public APIs that can return company‑level data (including contact information) when you provide an IP address.  
All of them expose a simple HTTP endpoint that you can call from any language (curl, Python, JavaScript, etc.).  
I’ll list the most popular ones, show a quick example request, and point out the fields that contain the company name, phone, address, and other contact details.

| API | Endpoint | Key fields returned | Notes |
|-----|----------|---------------------|-------|
| **ipinfo.io** | `https://ipinfo.io/<IP>/json` | `company.name`, `company.domain`, `company.type`, `company.phone`, `company.address` | Free tier: 50k requests/month. Requires a token for higher limits. |
| **ipwhois.io** | `https://ipwhois.app/json/<IP>` | `company.name`, `company.domain`, `company.type`, `company.phone`, `company.address` | Free tier: 10k requests/day. |
| **ipgeolocation.io** | `https://api.ipgeolocation.io/ipgeo?apiKey=<API_KEY>&ip=<IP>` | `company.name`, `company.domain`, `company.type`, `company.phone`, `company.address` | Free tier: 1k requests/day. |
| **ipapi.co** | `https://ipapi.co/<IP>/json/` | `org` (organization name) | Does **not** return phone or address. |
| **ipstack.com** | `https://api.ipstack.com/<IP>?access_key=<API_KEY>` | `company.name`, `company.domain`, `company.type`, `company.phone`, `company.address` | Free tier: 10k requests/month. |

---

## 1. ipinfo.io – most complete

### Request

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_TOKEN" \
     https://ipinfo.io/8.8.8.8/json
```

> Replace `YOUR_TOKEN` with your ipinfo.io API key.  
> If you don’t have a key, you can still try the free tier (no auth header) but you’ll hit the rate limit quickly.

### Sample Response

```json
{
  "ip": "8.8.8.8",
  "hostname": "dns.google",
  "city": "Mountain View",
  "region": "California",
  "country": "US",
  "loc": "37.3860,-122.0840",
  "postal": "94035",
  "timezone": "America/Los_Angeles",
  "org": "AS15169 Google LLC",
  "company": {
    "name": "Google LLC",
    "domain": "google.com",
    "type": "ISP",
    "phone": "+1-650-253-0000",
    "address": "1600 Amphitheatre Parkway, Mountain View, CA 94043, USA"
  }
}
```

### What you get

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `company.name` | Company name |
| `company.domain` | Company domain |
| `company.type` | ISP / Hosting / Corporate |
| `company.phone` | Phone number (may be missing) |
| `company.address` | Physical address (may be missing) |

---

## 2. ipwhois.io – similar to ipinfo

### Request

```bash
curl https://ipwhois.app/json/8.8.8.8
```

### Sample Response

```json
{
  "ip": "8.8.8.8",
  "type": "IPv4",
  "continent": "North America",
  "continent_code": "NA",
  "country": "United States",
  "country_code": "US",
  "region": "California",
  "region_code": "CA",
  "city": "Mountain View",
  "latitude": 37.386,
  "longitude": -122.084,
  "company": {
    "name": "Google LLC",
    "domain": "google.com",
    "type": "ISP",
    "phone": "+1-650-253-0000",
    "address": "1600 Amphitheatre Parkway, Mountain View, CA 94043, USA"
  }
}
```

---

## 3. ipgeolocation.io – requires API key

### Request

```bash
curl "https://api.ipgeolocation.io/ipgeo?apiKey=YOUR_API_KEY&ip=8.8.8.8"
```

### Sample Response

```json
{
  "ip": "8.8.8.8",
  "continent_name": "North America",
  "country_name": "United States",
  "region_name": "California",
  "city_name": "Mountain View",
  "latitude": "37.386",
  "longitude": "-122.084",
  "company": {
    "name": "Google LLC",
    "domain": "google.com",
    "type": "ISP",
    "phone": "+1-650-253-0000",
    "address": "1600 Amphitheatre Parkway, Mountain View, CA 94043, USA"
  }
}
```

---

## 4. ipapi.co – only organization name

If you only need the organization name (no phone/address), ipapi.co is a lightweight option:

```bash
curl https://ipapi.co/8.8.8.8/json/
```

Response snippet:

```json
{
  "ip": "8.8.8.8",
  "org": "AS15169 Google LLC",
  ...
}
```

---

## 5. ipstack.com – similar to ipinfo

```bash
curl "https://api.ipstack.com/8.8.8.8?access_key=YOUR_ACCESS_KEY"
```

Response snippet:

```json
{
  "ip": "8.8.8.8",
  "type": "ipv4",
  "continent_name": "North America",
  "country_name": "United States",
  "region_name": "California",
  "city_name": "Mountain View",
  "company": {
    "name": "Google LLC",
    "domain": "google.com",
    "type": "ISP",
    "phone": "+1-650-253-0000",
    "address": "1600 Amphitheatre Parkway, Mountain View, CA 94043, USA"
  }
}
```

---

## Quick Python example (using `requests`)

```python
import requests

def get_company_info(ip, api_key=None):
    url = f"https://ipinfo.io/{ip}/json"
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}"} if api_key else {}
    r = requests.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=5)
    r.raise_for_status()
    data = r.json()
    company = data.get("company", {})
    return {
        "name": company.get("name"),
        "domain": company.get("domain"),
        "type": company.get("type"),
        "phone": company.get("phone"),
        "address": company.get("address")
    }

print(get_company_info("8.8.8.8", api_key="YOUR_TOKEN"))
```

---

### Which one to pick?

| Use case | Recommended API |
|----------|-----------------|
| **Most complete data** (name, phone, address) | `ipinfo.io` or `ipwhois.io` |
| **Free tier, no key** | `ipinfo.io` (no auth header) |
| **Higher request limits** | `ipwhois.io` (10k/day) or `ipstack.com` (10k/month) |
| **Only org name** | `ipapi.co` |

All of these services return JSON, so you can parse the response in any language.  
If you need more granular control (e.g., rate limiting, caching), you can wrap the API call in your own service layer.
